reader_question: How many governments of each kind does the country have?
grade_line: Documented: the Census Bureau’s 2022 Census of Governments
title: Special districts were the most common kind of government in the country in 2022, 39,555 of the 90,888 the Census Bureau counted.
notes: The Census Bureau counts a school system run by a state, county, city or township as part of that government, so the 12,546 independent school districts leave those systems out.
chart_notes: The circles run largest first. The circle the title names, special districts, takes the text’s ink, with its count inside; the others are gray with a thin edge, named beside. The federal government and the 50 states print in words beside the key, since at this scale the federal government’s circle would be under a pixel across and the states’ a few pixels.
alt: Circles sized by area for five kinds of local government in 2022: special districts, 39,555, the largest; municipalities, 19,491; townships, 16,214; independent school districts, 12,546; and counties, 3,031. One federal government and 50 state governments print in words.
